raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Related to #62028. Serving `nvidia/Gemma-4-31B-IT-NVFP4` with `AEON-7/gemma-4-31B-it-speculator.eagle3-NVFP4` crashed while copying a BF16 `lm_head` row of width 5376 into a packed NVFP4 parameter of width 2688.

## Claims

- Speculators extraction copies the outer `quantization_config` onto the draft config and leaves the caller's `transformer_layer_config` unchanged.
- Flat ModelOpt configs honor `exclude_modules`, and fall back to compressed-tensors `ignore` only when `exclude_modules` is absent. Excluded `embed_tokens` and `lm_head` stay unquantized. `kv_cache_quant_algo` is normalized to uppercase.
- Draft loaders pin `quant_config` after `VllmConfig` construction. `replace()` reruns `__post_init__`, which would otherwise refill a missing quant config from the target model.
- When a draft has both `d2t` and a bool `t2d`, load fails unless every draft id lands on a distinct `t2d` target. Extra `t2d` marks warn. A non-bool `t2d`, or a missing tensor, skips the check.

## Validation

Unit tests on CPU (`VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu` for the ModelOpt cases). 18 passed:

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py::test_flat_modelopt_nvfp4_config_honors_exclude_modules \
  tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py::test_flat_modelopt_ignore_is_exclude_modules_fallback \
  tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py::test_flat_modelopt_exclude_modules_takes_precedence_over_ignore \
  tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py::test_flat_modelopt_nvfp4_reads_kv_cache_quant_algo \
  tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py::test_flat_modelopt_kv_cache_scheme_still_maps_to_fp8 \
  tests/quantization/test_modelopt.py::test_modelopt_nvfp4_leaves_excluded_parallel_lm_head_unquantized \
  tests/transformers_utils/test_speculators_dspark_config.py \
  tests/model_executor/test_eagle_vocab_map.py -q
```

SM120 results are from @waynehacking8 on main `153a17166e` plus the load fix, and were not re-run here:

- The 2688 vs 5376 mismatch is gone, and greedy target completions match.
- The published draft accepts about 7% (mean length 1.29 at 4 speculative tokens). Its `d2t` is a BF16 round trip of `RedHatAI/gemma-4-31B-it-speculator.eagle3`: 30,732 of 32,000 draft ids are wrong, while `t2d` is intact. Restoring only `d2t` raises acceptance to 62% (mean length 3.50, against 3.58 for the BF16 source).
- Single-stream chat throughput is 93.7 tok/s against 40.9 without a draft, at the same chat GSM8K (0.984).

The vocab-map check then refuses that published NVFP4 checkpoint until `d2t` is restored. There is no env-var override.

```bash
vllm serve nvidia/Gemma-4-31B-IT-NVFP4 \
  --quantization modelopt \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"eagle3","model":"AEON-7/gemma-4-31B-it-speculator.eagle3-NVFP4","num_speculative_tokens":4,"draft_tensor_parallel_size":1}'
```

## Details

The crash is the excluded `lm_head`. ModelOpt NVFP4 applies a packed linear method to `LinearBase` and `ParallelLMHead`. `VocabParallelEmbedding` does not get that method. The draft stores ModelOpt metadata on the outer speculators `config.json`, with `exclude_modules: ["lm_head", "embed_tokens"]`. `embed_tokens.weight` is BF16 `[262144, 5376]` and `lm_head.weight` is BF16 `[32000, 5376]`. Linear weights are packed NVFP4.

Extraction kept only `transformer_layer_config`, so the draft lost that quant block. The flat parser read compressed-tensors `ignore` and dropped `exclude_modules`. The weight loader then copied a BF16 row into a packed parameter.

The draft already resolved its own quant config through `get_draft_quant_config()`. It did not inherit the target scheme. Pinning after construction keeps an explicit `None` from being replaced by the target config still attached during draft setup.

`d2t[i]` is the offset from draft id `i` to target id `i + d2t[i]`. Sampling uses only `d2t`. `t2d` is a bool mask, so `d2t` cannot be rebuilt from it. A BF16-rounded `d2t` still loads on main and proposes the wrong tokens. This check rejects that case. It does not fix the #62028 shape mismatch, and the published AEON-7 checkpoint still does not load until `d2t` matches `t2d`.

This is not #49900 (compressed-tensors `draft_model` prefix) and not #59040 (MTP fc quantization). No other open PR covers this exclude path.

AI assistance was used. The submitting human should review every changed line before requesting review.

## Test plan

- [x] Unit tests listed above (18 passed).
- [x] Load the #62028 draft on SM120 and confirm the 2688 vs 5376 mismatch is gone (reported by @waynehacking8).
- [ ] Confirm a checkpoint whose `d2t` matches `t2d` still loads on GPU, and that the published NVFP4 `d2t` is rejected with the new error.

@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import (
+    capture_eagle_vocab_map,
+    validate_eagle_vocab_map,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+
+
+def _mask_for(target_ids: torch.Tensor, vocab_size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    t2d = torch.zeros(vocab_size, dtype=torch.bool)
+    t2d[target_ids] = True
+    return t2d
+
+
+def test_capture_records_d2t_and_skips_t2d():
+    vocab_map: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    d2t = torch.zeros(2, dtype=torch.int64)
+    t2d = torch.zeros(4, dtype=torch.bool)
+
+    assert not capture_eagle_vocab_map("d2t", d2t, vocab_map)
+    assert capture_eagle_vocab_map("model.t2d", t2d, vocab_map)
+    assert vocab_map["d2t"] is d2t
+    assert vocab_map["t2d"] is t2d
+
+
+def test_matching_d2t_and_t2d_pass():
+    draft_ids = torch.arange(8)
+    target_ids = draft_ids + 20
+    vocab_map = {
+        "d2t": target_ids - draft_ids,
+        "t2d": _mask_for(target_ids, 40),
+    }
+    validate_eagle_vocab_map(vocab_map)
+
+
+def test_d2t_alone_is_not_checked():
+    validate_eagle_vocab_map({"d2t": torch.tensor([1, 2])})
+
+
+def test_bf16_round_trip_d2t_is_rejected():
+    draft_ids = torch.arange(32)
+    # Offsets past bf16's exact integer range, so the round trip moves ids.
+    target_ids = draft_ids * 1000 + 3
+    d2t = target_ids - draft_ids
+    rounded = d2t.to(torch.bfloat16).to(torch.int64)
+    assert not torch.equal(rounded, d2t)
+
+    vocab_map = {
+        "d2t": rounded,
+        "t2d": _mask_for(target_ids, int(target_ids.max()) + 1),
+    }
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="d2t does not match t2d"):
+        validate_eagle_vocab_map(vocab_map)
+
+
+def test_one_displaced_draft_id_is_rejected():
+    draft_ids = torch.arange(4)
+    target_ids = draft_ids + 10
+    d2t = target_ids - draft_ids
+    # Land on an in-range target id that t2d does not mark.
+    d2t[1] += 5
+    vocab_map = {"d2t": d2t, "t2d": _mask_for(target_ids, 20)}
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="1 of 4"):
+        validate_eagle_vocab_map(vocab_map)
+
+
+def test_extra_t2d_marks_are_allowed():
+    draft_ids = torch.arange(4)
+    target_ids = draft_ids + 10
+    t2d = _mask_for(target_ids, 20)
+    t2d[0] = True
+    validate_eagle_vocab_map(
+        {"d2t": target_ids - draft_ids, "t2d": t2d},
+    )
+
+
+def test_duplicate_target_is_rejected():
+    # draft ids 0 and 1 both land on target 10.
+    d2t = torch.tensor([10, 9, 10, 10])
+    targets = torch.arange(4) + d2t
+    vocab_map = {"d2t": d2t, "t2d": _mask_for(torch.unique(targets), 20)}
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="shares a target"):
+        validate_eagle_vocab_map(vocab_map)
+
+
+def test_non_bool_t2d_is_skipped():
+    validate_eagle_vocab_map(
+        {
+            "d2t": torch.tensor([1, 2]),
+            "t2d": torch.ones(4, dtype=torch.int64),
+        }
+    )

     assert isinstance(method, UnquantizedLinearMethod)
 
 
+def test_flat_modelopt_nvfp4_config_honors_exclude_modules():
+    """Flat ModelOpt configs record skipped layers in exclude_modules."""
+    config = ModelOptNvFp4Config.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "modelopt",
+            "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+            "kv_cache_quant_algo": None,
+            "exclude_modules": ["lm_head", "embed_tokens"],
+        }
+    )
+    assert config.exclude_modules == ["lm_head", "embed_tokens"]
+    assert config.is_layer_excluded("lm_head")
+    assert config.is_layer_excluded("model.embed_tokens")
+
+    method = config.get_quant_method(_mock_lm_head(), prefix="lm_head")
+    assert isinstance(method, UnquantizedLinearMethod)
+    layer = torch.nn.Module()
+    with (
+        patch(
+            "vllm.model_executor.parameter.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank",
+            return_value=0,
+        ),
+        patch(
+            "vllm.model_executor.parameter.get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size",
+            return_value=1,
+        ),
+    ):
+        method.create_weights(
+            layer,
+            input_size_per_partition=64,
+            output_partition_sizes=[32],
+            input_size=64,
+            output_size=32,
+            params_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            weight_loader=lambda *args, **kwargs: None,
+        )
+    assert tuple(layer.weight.shape) == (32, 64)
+    assert layer.weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+
+    embed = Mock(spec=VocabParallelEmbedding)
+    embed.__class__ = VocabParallelEmbedding
+    assert config.get_quant_method(embed, prefix="model.embed_tokens") is None
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import LinearBase
+
+    linear = Mock(spec=LinearBase)
+    linear.__class__ = LinearBase
+    quantized = config.get_quant_method(linear, prefix="model.layers.0.mlp.down_proj")
+    assert isinstance(quantized, ModelOptLinearMethod)
+
+
+def test_flat_modelopt_ignore_is_exclude_modules_fallback():
+    """Compressed-tensors flat configs still record skips under ignore."""
+    config = ModelOptNvFp4Config.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "modelopt",
+            "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+            "ignore": ["lm_head"],
+        }
+    )
+    assert config.exclude_modules == ["lm_head"]
+    assert config.is_layer_excluded("lm_head")
+
+
+def test_flat_modelopt_exclude_modules_takes_precedence_over_ignore():
+    config = ModelOptNvFp4Config.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "modelopt",
+            "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+            "exclude_modules": ["embed_tokens"],
+            "ignore": ["lm_head"],
+        }
+    )
+    assert config.exclude_modules == ["embed_tokens"]
+
+
+def test_flat_modelopt_nvfp4_reads_kv_cache_quant_algo():
+    config = ModelOptNvFp4Config.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "modelopt",
+            "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+            "kv_cache_quant_algo": "fp8",
+            "exclude_modules": [],
+        }
+    )
+    assert config.kv_cache_quant_algo == "FP8"
+
+
+def test_flat_modelopt_kv_cache_scheme_still_maps_to_fp8():
+    config = ModelOptFp8Config.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_method": "modelopt",
+            "quant_algo": "FP8",
+            "kv_cache_scheme": {"type": "float", "num_bits": 8},
+            "ignore": ["lm_head"],
+        }
+    )
+    assert config.kv_cache_quant_method == "FP8"
+    assert config.exclude_modules == ["lm_head"]
+
+
 def test_modelopt_mixed_precision_quantizes_parallel_lm_head():
     config = _mixed_precision_config(
         {"lm_head": {"quant_algo": "NVFP4", "group_size": 16}}

+def capture_eagle_vocab_map(
+    name: str,
+    loaded_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    vocab_map: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+) -> bool:
+    """Record an Eagle ``d2t`` or ``t2d`` tensor.
+
+    Returns True when ``name`` is ``t2d``, which is not a model parameter and
+    must be skipped by the weight loader. ``d2t`` is recorded and still loaded.
+    """
+    if "t2d" in name:
+        vocab_map["t2d"] = loaded_weight
+        return True
+    if "d2t" in name:
+        vocab_map["d2t"] = loaded_weight
+    return False
+
+
+def validate_eagle_vocab_map(vocab_map: Mapping[str, torch.Tensor]) -> None:
+    """Raise if ``d2t`` does not land on ``t2d``.
+
+    Draft id ``i`` maps to target id ``i + d2t[i]``. Each of those ids must be
+    in range, marked by ``t2d``, and distinct. Extra ``t2d`` marks are ignored.
+
+    Args:
+        vocab_map: Tensors recorded by :func:`capture_eagle_vocab_map`.
+
+    Raises:
+        ValueError: Both tensors are present and disagree.
+    """
+    d2t = vocab_map.get("d2t")
+    t2d = vocab_map.get("t2d")
+    if d2t is None or t2d is None:
+        return
+
+    d2t_ids = d2t.detach().to(device="cpu", dtype=torch.int64).reshape(-1)
+    t2d_mask = t2d.detach().to(device="cpu").reshape(-1)
+    if t2d_mask.dtype != torch.bool:
+        logger.warning(
+            "Skipping Eagle d2t/t2d check; t2d dtype is %s, expected bool.",
+            t2d_mask.dtype,
+        )
+        return
+
+    n_draft = int(d2t_ids.shape[0])
+    targets = torch.arange(n_draft) + d2t_ids
+    in_range = (targets >= 0) & (targets < t2d_mask.shape[0])
+    hits = torch.zeros(n_draft, dtype=torch.bool)
+    if bool(in_range.any()):
+        hits[in_range] = t2d_mask[targets[in_range]]
+    n_hit = int(hits.sum().item())
+    n_marked = int(t2d_mask.sum().item())
+    n_unique = int(torch.unique(targets).numel()) if n_draft else 0
+    if n_hit == n_draft and n_unique == n_draft:
+        if n_marked != n_draft:
+            logger.warning_once(
+                "Eagle t2d marks %d target ids for a draft vocab of %d. "
+                "Extra marks are ignored.",
+                n_marked,
+                n_draft,
+            )
+        return
+
+    details = [f"{n_unique} distinct targets, t2d marks {n_marked}"]
+    if n_hit != n_draft:
+        details.insert(
+            0,
+            f"{n_draft - n_hit} of {n_draft} draft ids map outside t2d",
+        )
+    if n_unique != n_draft:
+        n_shared = n_draft - n_unique
+        if n_shared == 1:
+            shared = "1 draft id shares a target with another draft id"
+        else:
+            shared = f"{n_shared} draft ids share a target with another draft id"
+        details.insert(0, shared)
+    raise ValueError(
+        "Eagle d2t does not match t2d: "
+        + "; ".join(details)
+        + ". Each draft id must map to a distinct target id that t2d marks."
+    )
+

On an RTX PRO 6000 (SM120), main `153a17166e` with this PR loads the draft from #62028 (main fails with the 2688 vs 5376 size mismatch) and the target's greedy completions are identical, but only 7% of draft tokens are accepted (mean acceptance length 1.29 at 4 speculative tokens). That comes from the checkpoint: its `d2t` is the BF16 round trip of the source draft's (RedHatAI/gemma-4-31B-it-speculator.eagle3), so 30,732 of the 32,000 draft ids map to the wrong target token while `t2d` is intact. With only `d2t` restored, the same NVFP4 draft accepts 62% (mean length 3.50, against 3.58 for the BF16 source), and single-stream chat throughput is 93.7 tok/s against 40.9 without a draft, at the same chat GSM8K (0.984). A load-time check that `arange + d2t` matches `t2d` would catch this; I can send one.
